tooltips.name: Optional label. Left empty = auto "YYYY-MM-DD → YYYY-MM-DD|∞".
tooltips.effectiveFrom: First calendar day (app timezone) this rate card applies to conversation-days.
tooltips.effectiveTo: Last calendar day inclusive. Leave empty for the open-ended current agreement. Creating a new open period auto-closes the previous open one the day before.
tooltips.currency: Deal currency for unit prices below (Administration → Currency). Empty = system default.
tooltips.packUnitPrice: Pack model: price per pack of N AI engagements. Empty = platform default (1.99).
tooltips.packSize: Pack model: AI engagements per pack. Empty = 4.
tooltips.extraBasePrice: Extra model: fixed charge once per conversation engaged that day. Empty = 0.99.
tooltips.extraUnitPrice: Extra model: price per overage engagement. Empty = 0.49.
tooltips.extraIncludedTurns: Extra model: reply engagements (AI answers to the customer) already included in each engaged conversation. Empty = 4.
tooltips.planIncludedUsage: Monthly free billable units from the plan (packs for pack model, engaged conversations for extra). Matches Pricing.html plans — Lite 200 / Essential 600 / Pro 1000. 0 = pay-as-you-go (all usage billed). Apply full-month report filters so FIFO franchise consumption is correct.
tooltips.creditUnitPrice: Credit model: price of one AI engagement credit. Every engagement costs 1 credit — customer reply, team @mention, follow-up or scheduled message. Empty = 0.49.
tooltips.planIncludedCredits: Credit model: free credits per calendar month, consumed in chronological order. Anything above is billed at the Credit Unit Price. 0 = pay-as-you-go. Not the same as Plan Included Usage, which counts conversations/packs. Apply full-month report filters.
